newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Boatmen's up on deal.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Boatmen's up on deal.

text.p: Boatmen's Bancshares Inc shares jumped to 55-1/2 in otherwise quiet U.S. pre-open trading from Thursday's 42-15/16 close after news it agreed to merge with NationsBank Corp.
Traders said NationsBank was trading at 90 ahead of the U.S. stock market opening, off from Thursday's 92-3/8 finish.

"NationsBank and Boatmen's stole the show. There's nothing else going on and a lot of people are out today" ahead of Monday's U.S. Labor Day holiday, a trader said. U.S. markets will be closed Monday.

NationsBank agreed to buy Boatmen's at a fixed exchange rate of 0.6525 share of NationsBank common for each share of Boatmen's common. After the merger, NationsBank, based in Charlotte, N.C., will have assets of $230 billion and a market capitalization of $33 billion.

Meanwhile, Dell Computer Corp shares traded higher at 69, up from Thursday's 66-5/8 finish after news that Dell will replace Varity Corp in the S&P 500 index after the close of trading September 5. Varity is merging with Lucas Industries Plc.
